data.notes: Confirmed January 2027 listings are still thin this far out, but Accra’s early-month calendar is anchored by Detty December spillover, Ada destination parties, and beach-club nightlife.

events.title: AFROSON1C X Edition 02
events.summary: West Africa-focused showcase festival and music industry conference returning to Accra with live showcases, panels, workshops, curated meetings and expanded multi-day programming after a sold-out debut.

events.title: Tropical Fiesta V
events.summary: A three-day, two-night resort getaway/private party festival outside Accra, powered by Livewire Events, Enjoyment Radio and Black Avenue Muzik, with artists, celebrity DJs, influencers and diaspora guests.

events.title: ALIV FEST 2026
events.summary: An 18-day Accra carnival/nightlife experience running into early January, with Afrobeats, Amapiano, drill and Afropop DJ sets, live acts, carnival rides, food and peak-night programming.

events.title: Afro Wave Tuesday
events.summary: Afrikana Beach House’s Afro Wave Tuesday is a beach-club night with Spinset soundtracking the evening with Afrobeats, Amapiano, and hip-hop from sunset until late.

events.title: One Night In Accra
events.summary: Chaleboyz-hosted Detty-season closing club night at Enzo Accra, centered on Afrobeats, Amapiano, Highlife, Hiplife, Afrofusion and Ghanaian anthems until 5 AM.

events.title: Freedom Parade
events.summary: Nkyinkyim Museum’s annual Freedom Parade is a body-painting and masquerade festival in Ada with live music, dance performances, and cultural activities.

events.title: Labadi Beach Networking Party
events.summary: A New Year beach link-up at Labadi Beach with Whizgee Ras, top DJs, late-night dancing and networking zones, running 8 PM to 5 AM.
